caption: Asymmetric (anchored) explicatio (#464). With the Spearmen selected, Shift+B widens the frontage the same way the plain B does, but holds the RIGHT flank: its corner file stands and every rear half-file steps into the interval on its file's left, so the whole widen lands off the LEFT flank, where the plain B stands the files next to the middle and opens each wing outward. Ctrl+B is the mirror (holds the left flank). Each man follows a man he can see; nobody teleports.
